warmup.name: Five Sentences
warmup.instruction: Write exactly five sentences. Stop, even if you want to keep going.

warmup.name: First Thought
warmup.instruction: Write the first thing that comes to mind without stopping.

character.name: What They Avoid
character.instruction: Write a paragraph about something your character refuses to talk about.

character.name: Habit Inventory
character.instruction: List five habits your character has when they’re alone.
character.constraint: At least two should contradict each other.

scene.name: Late Arrival
scene.instruction: Write a scene that starts after the important moment already happened.

scene.name: One Location
scene.instruction: Write a scene that never leaves a single physical space.

voice.name: Second Person Shift
voice.instruction: Rewrite a moment in second person.
